sentences.en: MARTIN: Good morning.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 早上好。

sentences.en: This is Burnham tourist office, Martin speaking.
sentences.zh: 这里是伯纳姆旅游办公室，马丁为您服务。

sentences.en: SUE: Oh, hello.
sentences.zh: SUE: 哦，您好。

sentences.en: I saw a poster about free things to do in the area, and it said people should phone you for information.
sentences.zh: 我看到一张关于本地区免费活动的海报，上面说人们可以打电话向您咨询相关信息。

sentences.en: I'm coming to Burnham with my husband and two children for a few days on June the 27th, or possibly the 28th, and I'd like some ideas for Example things to do on the 29th.
sentences.zh: 我将于6月27日（也可能是28日）与丈夫及两个孩子到伯纳姆游玩几天，想了解一下29日有哪些活动推荐。

sentences.en: MARTIN: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 好的，当然可以。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Then let's a start with a couple of events especially for children.
sentences.zh: 那么我们先从几项专为儿童设计的活动开始介绍吧。

sentences.en: The art gallery is holding an event called 'Family Welcome' that day, when there are activities and trails to use throughout the gallery.
sentences.zh: 当天美术馆将举办一场名为‘家庭欢迎日’的活动，馆内将设有各类互动活动及参观导览路线。

sentences.en: SUE: That sounds interesting.
sentences.zh: SUE: 听起来很有趣。

sentences.en: What time does it start?
sentences.zh: 活动几点开始？

sentences.en: MARTIN: The gallery opens at 10, and the 'Family Welcome' event runs from 10.30 until 2.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 美术馆上午10点开放，‘家庭欢迎日’活动时间为10:30至14:00。

sentences.en: o'clock.
sentences.zh: 点。

sentences.en: The gallery stays open until 5.
sentences.zh: 美术馆营业至下午5点。

sentences.en: And several times during the day, they're going to show a short film that the gallery has produced.
sentences.zh: 当天还会多次放映一部由该美术馆制作的短片。

sentences.en: It demonstrates how ceramics are made, and there'll be equipment and materials for children to have a go themselves.
sentences.zh: 短片展示了陶瓷的制作过程，并配有相关设备和材料，供孩子们亲自动手体验。

sentences.en: Last time they ran the event, there was a film about painting, which went down very well with the children, and they're now working on one about sculpture.
sentences.zh: 上一次举办该活动时，放映的是一部关于绘画的短片，深受孩子们喜爱；目前他们正在制作一部关于雕塑的短片。

sentences.en: SUE: like the sound of that.
sentences.zh: SUE: 我很喜欢这个想法。

sentences.en: And what other events happen in Burnham?
sentences.zh: 伯纳姆还有其他什么活动吗？

sentences.en: MARTIN: Well, do you all enjoy listening to music?
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 嗯，你们全家都喜欢听音乐吗？

sentences.en: SUE: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: SUE: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: MARTIN: Well there are several free concerts taking place at different times one or two in the morning, the majority at lunchtime, and a couple in the evening.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 嗯，有多场免费音乐会，在不同时段举行：一两场在凌晨，大部分在午间，还有几场在晚上。

sentences.en: And they range from pop music to Latin American.
sentences.zh: 这些音乐会涵盖从流行音乐到拉丁美洲音乐等多种类型。

sentences.en: SUE: The Latin American could be fun.
sentences.zh: SUE: 拉丁美洲音乐那场可能会很有趣。

sentences.en: What time is that?
sentences.zh: 那场是什么时候？

sentences.en: MARTIN: It's being repeated several times, in different places.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 这场音乐会将在不同地点多次上演。

sentences.en: They're performing in the central library at 1 o'clock, then at 4 it's in the City Museum, and in the evening, at 7.30.
sentences.zh: 他们将在中央图书馆于1点钟演出，下午4点则在市立博物馆，晚上7点半还有一场。

sentences.en: there's a longer concert, in the theatre.
sentences.zh: 晚上那场在剧院举行，时间更长一些。

sentences.en: SUE: Right.
sentences.zh: SUE: 好的。

sentences.en: I'll suggest that to the rest of the family.
sentences.zh: 我会向家里其他人推荐这个。

sentences.en: MARTIN: Something else you might be interested in is the boat race along the river.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 另一件您可能感兴趣的活动是沿河举行的划船比赛。

sentences.en: SUE: Oh, yes, do tell me about that.
sentences.zh: SUE: 哦，是的，请给我讲讲这个。

sentences.en: MARTIN: The race starts at Offord Marina, to the north of Burnham, and goes as far as Summer Pool.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 比赛起点是伯纳姆以北的奥福德码头，终点为萨默池。

sentences.en: The best place to watch it from is Charlesworth Bridge, though that does get rather crowded.
sentences.zh: 最佳观赛地点是查尔斯沃思桥，不过那里通常会相当拥挤。

sentences.en: Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 听力原文

sentences.en: SUE: And who's taking part?
sentences.zh: SUE: 那有哪些人参加呢？

sentences.en: MARTIN: Well, local boat clubs, but the standard is very high.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 主要是当地船艇俱乐部，但参赛水平非常高。

sentences.en: One of them came first in the West of England regional championship in May this year - it was the first time a team from Burnham has won.
sentences.zh: 其中一支队伍在今年5月赢得了英格兰西部地区锦标赛冠军——这是伯纳姆的队伍首次夺冠。

sentences.en: It means that next year they'll be representing the region in the national championship.
sentences.zh: 这意味着明年他们将代表该地区参加全国锦标赛。

sentences.en: SUE: Now I've heard something about Paxton Nature Reserve.
sentences.zh: SUE: 我最近听说了帕克斯顿自然保护区的事。

sentences.en: It's a good place for spotting unusual birds, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这是个观察稀有鸟类的好地方，不是吗？

sentences.en: MARTIN: That's right - throughout the year.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 没错——全年都适合。

sentences.en: There is a lake there, as well as a river, and they provide a very attractive habitat.
sentences.zh: 那里有一座湖泊，还有一条河流，它们共同构成了非常宜人的栖息地。

sentences.en: So it's good idea to bring binoculars if you have them.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你有双筒望远镜，最好带上。

sentences.en: And just at.
sentences.zh: 还有就是……

sentences.en: the moment you can see various flowers that are pretty unusual - the soil at Paxton isn't very common.
sentences.zh: 目前你还能看到多种相当罕见的花卉——帕克斯顿地区的土壤并不常见。

sentences.en: They're looking good right now.
sentences.zh: 这些花眼下开得正盛。

sentences.en: SUE: Right.
sentences.zh: SUE: 好的。

sentences.en: My husband will be particularly interested in that.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫会对这个特别感兴趣。

sentences.en: MARTIN: And there's going to be a talk and slide show about mushrooms - and you'll be able to go out.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 此外，还将举办一场关于蘑菇的讲座和幻灯片展示——之后你们还可以外出。

sentences.en: and pick some afterwards and study the different varieties.
sentences.zh: 采摘一些蘑菇，然后研究不同品种。

sentences.en: SUE: Uhuh.
sentences.zh: SUE: 嗯。

sentences.en: And is it possible for children to swim in the river?
sentences.zh: 孩子们可以在河里游泳吗？

sentences.en: MARTIN: Yes.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 可以。

sentences.en: Part of it has been fenced off to make it safe for children to swim in.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分河段已加装围栏，确保儿童游泳安全。

sentences.en: It's very shallow, and there's a lifeguard on duty whenever it's open.
sentences.zh: 河水很浅，且只要开放，现场就有救生员值守。

sentences.en: The lake iS too deep, so swimming isn't allowed there.
sentences.zh: 湖泊水太深，因此禁止游泳。

sentences.en: SUE: OK, we must remember to bring their swimming things, in case we go to Paxton.
sentences.zh: SUE: 好的，我们得记得带上孩子们的泳具，以防去帕克斯顿。

sentences.en: How long does it take to get there by car from Burnham?
sentences.zh: 从伯恩姆开车到那里要多久？

sentences.en: MARTIN: About 20 minutes, but parking is very limited, SO it's usually much easier to go by bus - and it takes about the same time.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 大约20分钟，但停车位非常有限，所以通常乘公交车前往更方便——耗时也差不多。

sentences.en: SUE: Right.
sentences.zh: SUE: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, I'll discuss the options with the rest of the family.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我会和家里其他人商量一下出行方案。

sentences.en: Thanks very much for all your help.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您的帮助。

sentences.en: MARTIN: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 不客气。

sentences.en: SUE: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: SUE: 再见。

sentences.en: MARTIN: Bye.
sentences.zh: MARTIN: 再见。
